page.overview:
Who is Hayes?

Vice Admiral Hayes was a flag officer in Starfleet in the 2360s.

In 2369, after the had discovered the adrift in the Igo sector, Hayes contacted the Enterprise-D to inform them about a Cardassian warship attack on two Ferengi freighters, fearing a large-scale Cardassian movement to the Igo sector if the USS Yosemite had been attacked by the Cardassians as well. This later turned out not to be the case. ()
